3.2.2.2.10 BswMLinScheduleIndication
Purpose:
Function called by LinSM to indicate the currently active schedule
table for a speciﬁc LIN channel.
Signature:
void BswM_LinSM_CurrentSchedule(
NetworkHandleType Network,
LinIf_SchHandleType CurrentSchedule
)
Modes:
The reported modes depend on the conﬁgured schedules in the Lin
Statemanager.
Example:
request LinScheduleIndication LinSM1_CurrentSchedule {
processing IMMEDIATE
initialValue TBD
source MyLinSM.LinSMChannel
}
caption: 3.2.2.2.10 BswMLinScheduleIndication

targets.why: LinSM indication of current schedule to BswM
